name: The Journey Home
description:
About This Game

The Journey Home is a deeply emotional, atmospheric side-scrolling adventure crafted by a husband-and-wife duo, with one half of the team bringing her experience as a USA TODAY bestselling author to the game’s story.

 

A World in Motion

Journey through an ever-evolving world where environments materialize and dissolve around you.

Hitch a Ride

No need to travel alone. Hitch rides with ethereal fireflies, giant birds, luminescent jellyfish, or take control of a flying car.

 

The Shape of Time

Shift between ages as you explore this world. Go from young to old, and from old to young.

 

Master Your Mind

Use telekinetic powers to interact with objects, structures, and living creatures.

 

Many Ways Forward

Climb, swim, walk, run, jump, push, and swing your way through a surreal world.

 

Find what you came for. This is your journey home.
short_desc: Some answers can only be found by going within. In a world beyond the boundaries of time and space, your journey awaits. A stress-free atmospheric side-scrolling adventure.
